query: Which NAV service tiers run on APPSRV01 and what databases do they point at?
expected_behavior: Runs the inventory script with -ComputerName APPSRV01 (read-only)
Reports per instance: status, service account, database server/name, and ports from CustomSettings.config
Flags any instance where CustomSettings.config could not be located/parsed instead of omitting it silently

query: Is the Job Queue NAS configured and running on this server?
expected_behavior: Identifies NAS instances and their startup codeunit/method/argument from the inventory JSON
Distinguishes 'service running' from 'NAS startup parameters configured for Job Queue'
States clearly when no NAS instance exists rather than guessing

query: Restart the NAV service tier - users report stale data.
expected_behavior: Treats restart as opt-in (-Restart -Instance) and warns it disconnects all active RTC clients
Confirms the specific instance before acting when several exist
Verifies the service came back up and reports the result
